status: Single-reader native source observations, not calibrated ground truth
method: Unmarked 160 by 140 source-pixel crops centered at three fixed projected right-side stations, inspected before evaluating the RGB path result. Intervals include the noisy foil-to-silver transition.
limitation: Three stations cannot certify the entire side. The ordinary physical frame is inset on several sides; changing the printed frame alone cannot establish full-card accuracy. Historical annotations are unchanged.
